scope: Real asset workshop with a controlled bridge. Failure, retry, duplicate mutations, project isolation, partial results, keyboard and narrow layout; not real image inference or art approval.

checks.label: provider rejection preserves prompt and unlocks retry
invalid seed is rejected without dispatch
same-tick duplicate generation dispatches once
pending mutation locks prompt and replace
partial batch reports successful count and failed alternative
backend warning is visible
keyboard can inspect a different alternative
replace explicitly requests one image despite three selected alternatives
failed restore is retryable
same-tick duplicate restore dispatches once and locks generation
project switch clears old selection, history and preview
late prior-project response cannot populate castle results
new genre generates into its own project with create intent
optional metadata failures preserve selected artwork and preview
unknown history disables restore without hiding the registered artwork
refreshing inspection recovers history and usage information
narrow workshop has no document overflow
frontend test stays hidden
late response after unmount has no renderer error
tested sources unchanged
